body:
On the back: “late Wednesday, emerald flecks in the cab after the crop trial. the chickens stopped moving. Later, the back road closed.”

I asked for the old page back after the new instructions arrived. They said it had been destroyed, but its corner was still in my pocket.

I wrote the time before I went back for the others. The clock may have been slow; the second vehicle was already gone.
title: Cab note — late Wednesday
gloss: A personal field trace precedes the visible emergency response.
rival_reading: Responders could have collected the emerald flecks while crossing treated land; the note or objects do not prove the program began the emergency.
